sections.title: Sound of letter Ka
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (Ka) /kaː/. Its main sound appears in (Kind) /kɪnt/, which means child. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say Ka
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment. Then let the air burst out with a strong puff of breath. For the second sound, release the air gently without a puff. Touch your throat. You feel no shake because the voice is off.

sections.title: Spelling rules for Ka
paragraphs: Before a stressed vowel, this letter is aspirated, meaning followed by a small puff of air. You hear this puff in (Kind) /kʰɪnt/. You can also hear it in (Katze) /ˈkʰat͡sə/. After an s sound, or in an unstressed syllable, release the burst cleanly without extra air. You hear this smooth sound in (Skelett) /skeˈlɛt/ and in (Fabrik) /faˈbʁiːk/.

sections.title: Comparing Ka to English
paragraphs: This letter sounds just like the k in kite or skin. Hold your hand before your mouth. When a stressed vowel follows, make sure you feel a clear puff of air. After an s sound, release the burst gently with no extra puff.
